sources.entry: Chrome MySQL Admin - Powerful Chrome app to manage your MySQL. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon] ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]](https://github.com/yoichiro/chrome_mysql_admin)

summary.one_liner: ChromeMyAdmin is a Chrome app source repository for managing and operating a MySQL server from the browser.
summary.what_it_does: The repository holds the source code for the Chrome app "ChromeMyAdmin", which is used to manage and operate MySQL servers. The README says the app can be installed from the Chrome Web Store. It describes a build flow using git clone, npm install, and grunt. The listed dependencies are encoding.js, crypto-js, Forge, and mysql_js_driver. The README does not describe specific features such as query editing, table browsing, or user management.
use_cases: manage a MySQL server from a browser
run a Chrome app for MySQL administration
build a Chrome MySQL client from source
notable: Chrome app for managing MySQL servers
Installable from the Chrome Web Store
caveats: The README does not describe the feature set in detail
Relies on the Chrome app platform, which the README does not discuss in terms of its current support status
